title: Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2611.32631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. translated_title: 生成模式对齐的合成对话并度量其多样性
translated_abstract: 训练或评估一个将对话转换为结构化记录的模型需要成对数据，即一段对话文本加上它应被转换成的准确记录。这样的成对数据标注成本高昂，而且在敏感领域中甚至根本难以获得。因此，我们以相反的顺序来构建它们：先采样一个符合模式的有效记录，然后据此撰写对话，并可选地由对话合成语音，这样标签先于文本存在，无需任何标注步骤。简单地用提示词让语言模型生成此类对话，只会产生单一对话的微小变体，因此我们加入了采样的变化配置、人物角色以及规定记录字段出现顺序的主题规划，作为显式的变化机制。我们通过嵌入空间来度量最终传导到输出的变化程度，其中嵌入方差分布在约两倍半数量的独立方向上。
tldr: 该论文提出“先记录后对话”的逆序合成方法，通过先采样符合模式的有效记录再生成对话，无需人工标注即可获得成对数据，并利用变化配置、人物角色和主题规划等显式机制显著提升合成对话的多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reverse-order synthesis approach that generates schema-valid records before writing dialogues, eliminating the need for annotation, and employs explicit variation mechanisms—sampled variation configurations, personas, and topic plans—to substantially increase the diversity of synthetic dialogues.
